CanonicalRecord.title: CanonicalRecord
CanonicalRecord.description: One canonical sealed W036 record tagged by object class — the object a projection is computed over.

SealedProgramOfWork.title: SealedProgramOfWork
SealedProgramOfWork.description: The sealed program of work: canonically ordered immutable content plus its SHA-256 content digest (exact-revision addressing).

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

SolutionId.title: SolutionId
SolutionId.description: Opaque solution-package identity: "solution:" followed by a lowercase slug (stable across versions).

WorkPackage.title: WorkPackage
WorkPackage.description: One work package of the realization graph: a realization variant, sorted activities, optional solution-line/world-entity links (Navigator identity preservation), resources, constraints, approvals, and verification gates.

WorkPackageId.title: WorkPackageId
WorkPackageId.description: Opaque work-package identity: "work-package:" followed by a lowercase slug.

SolutionLineId.title: SolutionLineId
SolutionLineId.description: Opaque solution-line identity: "line:" followed by a lowercase slug.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque acting principal: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 identity grammar).

ResourceAssignment.title: ResourceAssignment
ResourceAssignment.description: One resource assignment: an opaque resource reference with a canonical decimal quantity and unit.

OpaqueReference.title: OpaqueReference
OpaqueReference.description: Opaque, bounded, provider-neutral reference string owned by its producing system.

NonNegativeDecimal.title: NonNegativeDecimal
NonNegativeDecimal.description: Non-negative decimal amount as a canonical string (digest-safe, no exponent form).

ConstraintReference.title: ConstraintReference
ConstraintReference.description: Reference to a constraint in the W004 constraint-language grammar (opaque constraint id; referenced, never embedded).

WorkApproval.title: WorkApproval
WorkApproval.description: One work-package approval: the approving principal, the instant, and an optional note.

VerificationGate.title: VerificationGate
VerificationGate.description: One verification gate: the gated activity, an opaque evidence-producing method, criteria, sorted evidence references, and optional pass provenance.

GateId.title: GateId
GateId.description: Opaque verification-gate identity: "gate:" followed by a lowercase slug.

ActivityId.title: ActivityId
ActivityId.description: Opaque activity identity: "activity:" followed by a lowercase slug.

EvidenceReference.title: EvidenceReference
EvidenceReference.description: Reference to evidence in the W006 grammar: canonical SHA-256 content digest (exact-revision addressing).

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: One activity of the realization graph: planned quantity/cost/dates, sorted predecessors/successors, resources, responsible actor, constraints, actual progress/dates, blockers, evidence, confidence, and forecast finish.

BlockerRecord.title: BlockerRecord
BlockerRecord.description: One blocker record: description, the raising principal and instant, and an optional impact note.

BlockerId.title: BlockerId
BlockerId.description: Opaque blocker-record identity: "blocker:" followed by a lowercase slug.

ConfidenceState.title: ConfidenceState
ConfidenceState.description: Confidence of one delivery fact: acquisition method (stated/measured/estimated/derived/imported), a 0..1 value, optional interval and rationale.

MilestoneRecord.title: MilestoneRecord
MilestoneRecord.description: One milestone record: a dated achievement point over sorted activity ids, with status, optional reached instant and sorted evidence.

MilestoneId.title: MilestoneId
MilestoneId.description: Opaque milestone identity: "milestone:" followed by a lowercase slug.

SealedDeliveryRecord.title: SealedDeliveryRecord
SealedDeliveryRecord.description: The sealed delivery record: canonically ordered immutable state plus its SHA-256 content digest (exact-revision addressing of the delivery state).

DeliveryId.title: DeliveryId
DeliveryId.description: Opaque delivery-record identity: "delivery:" followed by a lowercase slug.

ObservationRecord.title: ObservationRecord
ObservationRecord.description: The sealed observation record: immutable evidence-capture content (delivery scope, subject, measure, evidence, uncertainty) plus its SHA-256 content digest.

DistinctionRecordId.title: DistinctionRecordId
DistinctionRecordId.description: Opaque semantic-distinction record identity: one of the nine kind prefixes followed by a lowercase slug.

DistinctionSubject.title: DistinctionSubject
DistinctionSubject.description: The subject of one distinction record: the owning solution plus a typed anchor (solution, line, work package, activity, milestone, program, or delivery id).

UncertaintyState.title: UncertaintyState
UncertaintyState.description: The uncertainty state of one delivery fact: provenance, freshness and confidence (all required — the decision-sufficiency rule preserves what is not known).

ProvenanceState.title: ProvenanceState
ProvenanceState.description: Provenance of one delivery fact: observed/reported/derived/assumed/imported/unknown, optional opaque source reference, optional acting principal.

FreshnessState.title: FreshnessState
FreshnessState.description: Freshness of one delivery fact: fresh/aging/stale/unknown plus the producer-supplied assessment instant.

Measure.title: Measure
Measure.description: One provider-neutral measure: quantity (value+unit), cost (amount+currency), instant, or progress (0..1 fraction).

QuantityMeasure.title: QuantityMeasure
QuantityMeasure.description: A quantity measure: canonical decimal value plus a unit-of-measure label.

CostMeasure.title: CostMeasure
CostMeasure.description: A cost measure: canonical decimal amount plus an ISO 4217 currency code.

InstantMeasure.title: InstantMeasure
InstantMeasure.description: An instant measure: a point in time in the canonical UTC form.

ProgressMeasure.title: ProgressMeasure
ProgressMeasure.description: A progress measure: a completion fraction between 0 and 1.

ObservationPayload.title: ObservationPayload
ObservationPayload.description: Observation payload: the delivery record it belongs to, the observation instant and observer, and the sorted evidence references.

ActualRecord.title: ActualRecord
ActualRecord.description: The sealed actual record: immutable authoritative delivery fact (derived from an accepted observation) plus its SHA-256 content digest.

ActualPayload.title: ActualPayload
ActualPayload.description: Actual payload: the delivery record, the observation this actual was converted from, and the actualization instant and principal.

SealedSolutionVersion.title: SealedSolutionVersion
SealedSolutionVersion.description: The sealed solution version envelope: canonically ordered immutable content plus its SHA-256 content digest (exact-revision addressing; hash-chained via previousVersionDigest).

SolutionLine.title: SolutionLine
SolutionLine.description: One solution line: quantity+unit line item with optional unit cost, optional world-entity link (Navigator identity preservation) and optional acquisition variant.

WorldEntityReference.title: WorldEntityReference
WorldEntityReference.description: Reference to a world-graph entity in the W002 world-model grammar (opaque entity id; referenced, never embedded).

SealedDistinctionRecord.title: SealedDistinctionRecord
SealedDistinctionRecord.description: The sealed semantic-distinction record: immutable kind-discriminated content plus its SHA-256 content digest (exact-revision addressing).

PredictionPayload.title: PredictionPayload
PredictionPayload.description: Prediction payload: optional opaque basis reference (e.g. a simulation run) and optional target instant.

EstimatePayload.title: EstimatePayload
EstimatePayload.description: Estimate payload: optional opaque estimation-method reference and optional low/high range in the measure unit.

BaselinePayload.title: BaselinePayload
BaselinePayload.description: Baseline payload: the approved solution version and its exact content digest (the version chain is the authority).

CommitmentPayload.title: CommitmentPayload
CommitmentPayload.description: Commitment payload: the committing principal, the commitment instant, and an optional acquisition-request link.

AcquisitionId.title: AcquisitionId
AcquisitionId.description: Opaque acquisition-request identity: "acquisition:" followed by a lowercase slug.

ForecastPayload.title: ForecastPayload
ForecastPayload.description: Forecast payload: the as-of instant of the validated delivery state it projects, and the earlier forecast it refines (forecast lineage only; never a prediction/baseline/actual).

OutcomePayload.title: OutcomePayload
OutcomePayload.description: Outcome payload: the outcome kind, sorted verification references, and an optional note.

LearningPayload.title: LearningPayload
LearningPayload.description: Learning payload: the lesson text and the sorted record links (context, solution, actuals, outcome).
